claims.evidence: Generic marketing language, no specific feature shown in photos to confirm or deny.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No material stamp, recycling code, or interior shot visible in either photo to confirm food-grade plastic or prior contents.
Only side views shown; base, underside, and interior not visible, so structural integrity and seal cannot be confirmed.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show hinged lid with two screw-cap bungs and three metal hinge clasps intact.

risks.risk: Drum may not be food-grade despite claim, could have been used for chemical/industrial storage
risks.proof: Close-up of recycling/material code molded on the barrel, plus a seller statement/photo of original use history or purchase receipt

risks.risk: Interior condition unknown (residue, odor, staining, rust on metal clasps)
risks.proof: Photo or short video of the open interior taken in daylight
risks.if_unproven: priced as unclean, requiring buyer-side washing/decontamination

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or leaks on base or underside not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Photo of the barrel tipped to show the full base, and a water-fill/leak test clip
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified structural integrity, worst case treated as leaking

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/volume affects unit pricing significantly
risks.proof: Photo of any embossed liter marking on the barrel, or a tape-measure shot of height/diameter
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common barrel size bracket until confirmed

risks.risk: Bungs/lid may not seal airtight despite being physically present
risks.proof: Short video of lid being closed and clasps latched, ideally with a tilt test

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any molded recycling code or food-grade marking on the plastic
Video or photo of the open interior in good light
Photo of the full base/underside of the drum
Photo of any embossed capacity/liter marking, or a tape measurement
Short video showing lid closing and latching with clasps, plus a tilt or water test
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a plastic storage barrel with lid, so it can be priced at worst case (non-food-grade, unverified interior/base condition, unknown capacity) pending the listed proofs.
